'''Bas-Ton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the brother of [[Therod-Ton]] and had two children; a son [[Phi-Ton]] and a daughter [[Yana-Ton]]. He also was the owner of a tea house in the [[Judicial Quarter]] of the [[Voss-Ka]] city.<ref name="TOR" />

Around [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="Voss-Date" /> Bas-Ton was kidnapped by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. His likeness was then used to craft an [[Imperial Agent]] into an identical copy of Bas-Ton, who would then go and replace him in his life. The Agent led a double life for a long time and not even after his death at the hands of a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] did the real Bas-Ton's family ever suspect anything.<ref name="TOR" />
